نحلولي (form XII)
# نَحْلَوْلِي (naḥlawlī) /naħ.law.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
# نَحْلَوْلِيَ (naḥlawliya) /naħ.law.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
